key_insight: PedDx classifies pediatric posterior fossa tumors from MRI, with higher accuracy among cases retained after confidence-based abstention.
clinical_relevance: This diagnostic AI research—not drug discovery—may inform future tumor assessment workflows but does not establish readiness for routine clinical use.
method: Uses T2-weighted MRI and pretrained 3DINO representations without tumor segmentation.
Combines calibrated predictions with confidence-based abstention.
Tests out-of-distribution cases, imaging perturbations, and independent agentic workflow execution.
evidence_signal: Evaluation included 492 discovery, 114 replication, 129 external-validation, and 40 independently tested cases; accuracy was 79.8%, 81.4%, and 92.5% in the latter three cohorts, rising to 90.5%, 88.7%, and 97.3% among non-abstained cases.
watch_item: Out-of-distribution cases produced confidently incorrect predictions, and imaging perturbations exposed acquisition and alignment vulnerabilities.
paper_title: PedDx: An End-to-End Deep Learning Framework for Pediatric Posterior Fossa Tumor Diagnosis with Agentic AI-Enabled Independent External Evaluation
